domains.name: Collection Description Operations
domains.scope: Reconcile accession evidence, descriptive hierarchies and image correspondence without inferring ownership or unsupported historical facts.

skills.name: accession-lot-inventory-reconciliation
skills.description: Reconcile a collection transfer list with received containers and their observed contents when an accession's scope or completeness is uncertain.

skills.name: archival-description-hierarchy-design
skills.description: Design a collection description hierarchy that preserves provenance and parent scope when organizing supplied groups, folders and items.

skills.name: digitization-image-item-correspondence
skills.description: Reconcile digitization captures with their physical items, leaves and sides when missing views, retakes or derivative files could distort coverage.
